## Services (freelance)

- Cross-platform mobile apps (React Native, Expo, Ionic, Cordova) for iOS & Android
- Web apps, dashboards & SEO-ready marketing sites (React, Astro, TypeScript)
- AI features & chatbots (OpenAI GPT, Gemini, prompt engineering)
- Real-time chat / voice / video & live streaming (WebRTC, Zego, TeleCMI, Exotel)
- Backend APIs & databases (Node.js, Express, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, PHP)
- Push notifications & OTP login (OneSignal, FCM/APNs, Msg91)
- Offline-first architecture, performance tuning, crash-free releases
- App Store + Google Play submission, ASO, analytics, OTA updates (EAS, CodeMagic)
- SEO, JSON-LD structured data, Core Web Vitals, Google Search Console setup

## Proof of work (shipped)

1. MService Enterprise FSM App — offline-first field-service app, 99.5% availability (Cordova, Kendo UI, Java plugins).
2. AstroVed Consumer App — high-traffic astrology app with live chat/voice/video & payments (React Native, Zego, Node.js, MongoDB).
3. AstroVedSpeaks — advisor marketplace with per-minute wallet billing (Node.js, WebRTC, TeleCMI/Exotel).
4. QuantumGPT — AI spiritual guidance platform, web + iOS + Android (React, React Native, OpenAI API, JWT subscriptions).
5. Planets360 — Vedic astrology web platform, 36-Guna matching, SEO JSON-LD (Astro, React, TypeScript, Zod).
6. Commodity Quant — real-time MCX trading signals app, Android/iOS/Web (Expo, TypeScript, OneSignal, Zustand, Msg91).
7. Pillai Center Academy — transformational learning app, iOS + Android (React Native, WordPress + BuddyBoss backend, in-app purchases, audio/video courses).
